title: A Comet Released 500 Bottles of Wine's Worth of Alcohol per Second

scenes.text: A comet once released the alcohol of 500 bottles of wine every second.
In 2015, astronomers aimed a radio telescope at Comet Lovejoy.
The Sun's heat made it spew out ethyl alcohol, the kind in wine and beer.
At its peak, that matched at least five hundred bottles of wine every second.
It also gave off a simple sugar and nineteen other organic molecules.
Comets like this may have helped deliver the ingredients for life. Five hundred bottles a second.

description:
Comet Lovejoy released as much alcohol as at least 500 bottles of wine every second at its peak.
In 2015 astronomers also found a simple sugar and 19 other organic molecules in its gas.
What would you name a comet bar?
first_comment: Would you try a drink made from comet water?
